discovery.result: YugaTech reports the official Philippine 8 GB / 256 GB X30 5G release at PHP 27,990 with authorized retail availability from October 28, 2022.
NTC's 2022 GEC includes Nokia TA-1450; HMD's exact-model specifications page identifies the same model code.
HMD launched Nokia X30 5G globally September 1, 2022; it states availability from that day. GSMArena separately lists September 21 as retail release.
NoypiGeeks reported a dated June 5, 2023 historical price change from PHP 27,990 to PHP 18,990 for the 8 GB / 256 GB model.
HMD's TA-1450 specifications support core hardware fields; its OS-upgrade count conflicts with the launch release and storage expansion is not specified.
Exact global 8/256 model page used only as a cross-check; disputed UFS type and microSD claims are not treated as settled local facts.

prices.excerpt: Philippine launch coverage lists PHP 27,990 for the Nokia X30 5G 8 GB / 256 GB; authorized nationwide retailers were reported to begin availability October 28, 2022.
NoypiGeeks reported a PHP 9,000 reduction from PHP 27,990 to PHP 18,990 for Nokia X30 5G, 8 GB RAM / 256 GB storage. Historical promotional price; no current availability inferred.
